directory.name: G.H. Pasta & Pizza
directory.note: Chef Brian Clevenger's General Harvest Restaurants took over the former Autumn space on Greenwood Ave N with a family-friendly pasta-and-pizza menu, opening the first week of February 2026.

directory.name: Pizza Twist
directory.style: Custom fusion pizza (halal options, Indian-fusion toppings)
directory.note: A fusion-pizza shop with a Northgate-area location offering build-your-own pies, halal meat options, and dishes like lamb kabob and butter chicken pizza.
